claim: The AWS WAF Anti-DDoS Managed Rule Group supersedes the Shield Advanced Layer 7 Auto Mitigation (L7AM) feature and detects and mitigates attacks within seconds rather than minutes; existing Shield Advanced customers can continue to use the legacy solution, and new Shield Advanced customers who require it contact AWS Support.
question: What supersedes Shield Advanced Layer 7 Auto Mitigation for HTTP flood protection?

qualifiers.condition: existing Shield Advanced customers can keep using the legacy feature; new customers ask AWS Support

evidence.quote: It supersedes the Layer 7 Auto Mitigation (L7AM) feature.

If you're an existing Shield Advanced customer, you can continue to use the legacy solution with existing or new AWS accounts. However, we encourage you to adopt the Anti-DDoS Managed Rule Group. The Anti-DDoS Managed Rule Group detects and mitigates attacks within seconds rather than minutes. If you're a new Shield Advanced customer and require access to the legacy solution, contact AWS Support.

note: d052, d059. Adjudicated 2026-10-12: 'becomes the default solution ... Starting March 26, 2026' stands in a sentence with a link and cannot be quoted, so the claim no longer says it.
